SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0) AS total_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 0 AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 0 AND is_deleted = 0) AS progress_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) AS complete_count

SELECT total_recent.board_type AS boardType, total_recent.num, total_recent.title, total_recent.category, total_recent.done, total_recent.created_at AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT '습득' AS board_type, num, fd_prdt_nm AS title, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '분실' AS board_type, num, lst_prdt_nm AS title, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ) AS total_recent ORDER BY total_recent.created_at DESC LIMIT 2
